name: implement a covariance-weighted risk computation matching a reference within tight tolerance
definition: Compute a quadratic-form risk measure from a weight vector and covariance matrix whose result is numerically identical to a reference implementation.
failure_mode: Different summation or numeric drift produces a mismatch beyond tolerance.

name: implement a paper-derived eigenvector magnitude reconstruction algorithm
definition: Derive the formula for coordinates of orthonormal eigenvectors from the spectrum of a symmetric matrix and its principal minors, and implement it numerically in numpy.
failure_mode: a wrong sign or formula pushes error beyond tolerance
